name: FrenchModelVariant157_HandleRequest
evidence: matching french_model_variant/variant157_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (a coloured ring fan opens under the other slot and 32 sprites with six-step trails fall from it, with two full-screen flashes); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request modulo 100, seeds the ring, the starting points and their histories and packs one texture word, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 before the ring phase, 4 while the sprites fall, 1 once at completion and 2 at the end; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md, notes/overlays/french-model-variant157.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the US header-140 and 270 images build the French source through model_variant/variant157_entry_usa.c, which adds the work-size printf and the 240-line flash, and bind its data names 0x24 higher. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
